differences.difference: v69 white topbar (portfolio name, Find a screen, Site selector, Window picker, avatar) is absent; app shell has no topbar (app-header 58-59 px transparent vs mock .topbar 65 px white).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) shared D1 shell row (no topbar/selector/search capability), owned by the shell seam; R88/R112 only cover the Window control on Work screens. Coordinate with batch 1 (shell) so one row covers all screens.

differences.difference: Page-local period controls replace the topbar Window: mini 'UTC day' + Previous/Next day; evidence From/To (UTC) + Show this period/Show all readings; evidence-analysis adds an 'Assessment day (UTC)' row; dispatch/analysis Previous day/Day (UTC)/Show/Next day. At 390 the dispatch row wraps to two lines (~50 px extra).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (a)-extension: same pattern as R88/R112 (page-local Window control, D1). R88/R112 rows name only Work screens, so propose (b) one new D1 row (or widen R88) listing these five W1 screens.

differences.difference: Panel sentences render at 14 px where the mock .prose is 12 px and panel copy 10-11 px (measured per-panel paragraph sizes: dispatch 32-38 paragraphs at 14 px, analysis 17, mini/evidence/health 1-9; mock 11-12 px). Mandatory UI-pass item.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (c) D3 shared typography defect (shell/shared typography fix slice), carried backlog item 'Panel sentence renders at 14 px vs mock .prose 12 px'.

differences.difference: Dark mobile header stretches on short 390 pages: app-frame__side 369 px on health refused (Site not found) and 272 px on the analysis spec-route page, versus 92 px on normal-length pages. Mandatory UI-pass item.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (c) D3 shared shell defect (backlog 'dark mobile header ~275-335 px on short 390 pages'); same fix owner as the shell seam.

differences.difference: Status strip content differs: mock shows assessment chips (Needs attention, Confidence: Low, Evidence limited, Asset assessment: Watch) and a right-aligned link (Inspect evidence / Portfolio evidence); app shows a currentness chip ('Using the latest checked readings', 'No capability conclusion yet', 'Asset condition cannot yet be judged') with a long sentence that wraps to a second line at 1440 on mini and health (health 'Battery page' link drops to line 2).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (no confidence/attention/capability assessment read) plus D4 for the replaced example text; the 1440 wrap is a layout point the Architect may rule D3 if a one-line strip is required.

differences.difference: Page subtitle: mock '60 kWp PV · 200 kWh battery · 40 kW genset · residential, clinic & grain mill'; app 'Overview · operating objectives for the selected period'.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D4 (example capacities); Architect to check whether Foundation already holds the capacities, in which case (c) D3.

differences.difference: Breadcrumb ends 'Sites / Kobo mini-grid' with no trailing 'Overview' crumb (mock 'Sites > Kobo Mini-grid > Overview').
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (c) D3 Low (faithful rendering possible).

differences.difference: Objective cards: mock has a status-tone top border (Dispatch amber) and a footer 'View detail' link on all five cards; app has no tone border, inline 'View detail' only on Service/Fuel/Renewable, none on Dispatch or Battery; values 'Assessed'/'Not available' vs 'Needs attention'/'Unknown'.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (c) D3 for the link placement and the Dispatch link (the Dispatch route exists); D1 for Battery (no condition read on Overview).

differences.difference: 'What happened in the selected hour': mock is a 5-event hour timeline with a conclusion sentence and a panel-head 'Open Dispatch' link; app reads a whole UTC day (single period, 'Hour not selected' note, day reading lines, disclosure). 1.40x at 1440 (priced/held/default).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (a) W1-F5b overage ruling exists (overages.json, not a register row) -> register as D1 (hour selection not supported) with the measured reason.

differences.difference: Operating context: mock kW power chart with a panel-head 'Single line diagram' link; app draws reading-arrival lanes per input (7-10 rows, 175-329 record links) and has no SLD link. 1.39-1.60x at 1440, 2.33-2.77x at 390.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL lanes: (a) W1-F5b overage ruling -> register D1 (no continuous power series). Missing 'Single line diagram' link: (c) D3 candidate, since /sites/:siteId/foundation/sld is mounted.

differences.difference: Needs attention: mock 3 numbered items each with a destination link; app 1 Finding item + overlap line + disclosure; at 1440 stretched to the Operating context row height (1.39-1.60x).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (a) W1-F5b overage ruling (stretch) -> register D4 (example items) with the stretch reason.

differences.difference: Bounded money consequence: amount format '0.00 to 15.82 USD' vs mock '$3.31-3.97'; the link is in the panel head ('Open fuel cost') vs in the body ('Open financial bridge'); app adds a chip, three note lines and a disclosure. 1.67-1.76x at 390.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL height: (a) W1-F5b overage ruling. Format and link: (b) D2 (needs owner approval), or (c) D3 if the mock format is required.

differences.difference: Next step: mock primary button 'Review recommendation'; app secondary 'Open the Finding' button + 'Open this day in Dispatch' link.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (the Overview read records no recommendation); Architect to check that the recommendation route cannot be linked from the selected Finding, otherwise (c) D3.

differences.difference: App adds a closed bottom disclosure 'Site record: identity, provenance and actions' that the mock lacks.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D2 (needs owner approval), else (c) D3 remove.

differences.difference: React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key ... Recorded reason 1' on the FAILED day (2026-10-07), at both widths. This is not a visual departure, but rows may be duplicated or omitted.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL defect for the W1 mini fix slice (Low): use unique keys. Not a register departure.

differences.difference: 'What we can conclude now': mock is a 5-row capability table (Capability / Evidence chip / What we can say / What is missing / Next step links); app shows readings-arrived bars, notes and 'Not available yet: capability-by-capability conclusions', plus a head link 'Open Evidence > Analysis for this period'.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) new D1 row (no reviewed capability assessment).

differences.difference: Data sources: mock per-source table (Status at window end / Quality chip / What it provides / Affects); evidence app = 3 status-fact rows + table (Accepted in period / Latest taken / Latest received / Readings) + 'Not available yet' line + disclosure (1.36-1.45x at 390). Health app lists 9 gateways with raw monospace IDs (s7-clock-offset ...), '1 device', Affects 'Not recorded' and an 'Open: Details' column (2.69x at 1440, 2.22x at 390).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL heights: (a) W1-F5b overage rulings (evidence 390 wrap; health one row per real gateway). Columns: (b) D1 (no per-source status, quality grade or affects rule). Raw gateway identifiers on health: (c) D3 copy item for the UI pass, same class as the 'c1 · EV_CONNECTOR' carried item.

differences.difference: 'Most useful next evidence': mock is a ranked 3-item list with action links; app shows 'Not available yet: ranking ...' and a factual list of sources with no accepted reading (0.60-0.72x).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (no reviewed next-evidence ranking rule).

differences.difference: The bottom notice drops the mock's first sentence ('Each next step can become a managed action'), keeping only 'Record-level detail ... on Evidence > Analysis'. The page description reads 'accepted readings and what is missing' where the mock has 'capability readiness and claim ceilings'.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (first-sentence-only pattern of R01/R03) and D4 for the description.

differences.difference: The panel 2 title reads 'How each limit is set'; the mock has 'How a claim limit is set'. This follows coordinator ruling 2026-10-17 (APPROVED_TITLE_CHANGES, W1-F2), which has no register row. The cold and EV analogues (coldSiteViews.tsx:1193, EvSiteViews.tsx:1152) use the mock title, so the screens are inconsistent.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) register as D2 (vocabulary), and have the Architect reconcile the mini, cold and EV wording; or (c) D3 restore the mock title.

differences.difference: Records table: the column is 'Taken' in UTC with the full date; the mock has 'Measured (EAT)', site-local and time-only, with KOBO-001 timezone Africa/Addis_Ababa stored. The app has no 'Missing / Inspect the gap' row, and its 'Open record' links lack the mock's external marker.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL time zone: (c) D3 candidate by the R23/R24 precedent (Site timezone exists), unless the Architect rules D2. Gap row: (b) D1.

differences.difference: Panel heights: 'Accepted records' 1.64x/1.70x; 'How each limit is set' 1.63x/1.81x with no selection, but 1.80x/2.18-2.27x with a selected assessment (result sentence, chip, Performance link, a 5-row x 4-column table inside disclosures, 11-12 disclosures) and 2.10x/2.38x refused. Record opened: 3.42x/3.33x.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (a) the W1-F5b reasons cover no-selection and record-opened. The selected and refused states exceed the 'result line + one closed details row' reason, so a new measured reason and ruling are needed.

differences.difference: A third tab row 'Overview | Analysis' sits under the Performance subtabs. The mock has no such row: dispatch reaches analysis through 'How this was worked out', and the mock's analysis is a Finding tab.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D2 (needs owner approval), linked to B2-30.

differences.difference: Metric card labels read 'Needed / Possibly avoidable / Cannot determine'; the mock has 'Candidate avoidable / Necessary / Indeterminate'.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (a) decision D-2026-10-04-plain-language-analysis-views, which has no register row -> register D2.

differences.difference: Sources and 15-minute blocks: the mock has a kW chart and 4 equal block tiles; the app has a generator bar, legend, chip, a 22-30 tile block grid and 2 disclosures. Measured 1.13-1.20x at 1440 and 2.22x/2.44x at 390 (limited-no-selection 1.58x).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (a) W1-F5b 390 overage ruling; missing kW chart: (b) D1 (no continuous power series).

differences.difference: Selected block: the mock has key/value rows with OBSERVED/DECLARED provenance tags, a 'How this was worked out' button and 'Open F-104'. The app has bullets, period facts and 'See how the readings lead to this outcome', with no Finding link.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 for provenance tags and per-input values; Architect to check the Finding link (a Finding overlaps 10-02 in the S4 data), possibly (c) D3.

differences.difference: The mock's amber notice between the panel pair and Coverage ('generator supplied useful battery charging ... not a demonstrated net saving') is absent. The DispatchSlots 'between' slot exists in the code but is empty in all captured states.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (no charging trade-off fact), else (c) D3.

differences.difference: Accepted sample coverage columns are Input / Set up / Accepted readings / Not good quality (11 rows + 'Show all 11 inputs'); the mock has Input / Endpoint support / What the samples cover / Claim impact (3 rows) and a panel-head 'View all evidence' link, which the app lacks. Measured 1.42x/1.31x at 1440.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL height: (a) W1-F5b overage ruling. Columns: (b) D1. Missing head link: (c) D3 candidate (Evidence route is mounted).

differences.difference: CRASH: a URL whose revision= is a window-assessment id (not an interval id) renders a blank page: TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 1)' in WindowView (PerformanceDispatch.tsx, selected.result.segments[blockIndex] on a non-interval revision loaded through getRevision). No error boundary or refusal is shown.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL defect (Medium) for the W1 mini fix slice: validate the revision shape and show a refusal. It is not a mock departure, but the page fails the 'refused state is honest' check.

differences.difference: Context: the mock `analysis` is the Finding F-104 Analysis tab (Findings breadcrumb, Finding title, Finding tabs, 'Open site'). The app renders the same three-panel grid as Site Performance > Dispatch > Analysis (?view=analysis), per the W1-UX mapping; the Finding 'Analysis' tab is 'Not available yet' (R21).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1/D2 register row recording the placement (no Finding-scoped analysis read).

differences.difference: The spec table's route pattern /sites/:siteId/performance/analysis is not the mounted route; the analysis view is /performance/dispatch?view=analysis. The spec pattern renders a misleading 'Awaiting evidence migration' panel for an unknown Performance subtab.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL spec-table correction (Architect). Unknown-subtab copy: (c) D3 Low or a Low defect.

differences.difference: Constraint comparison: the app columns are Block (UTC) / Outcome / Demand / Spare capacity / Recorded reason (1 or 30 rows) plus three explanation cards; the mock has Observed-declared input / Value / Test / Result with Supported/Not binding/Alternative chips (6 rows).
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (no per-constraint test results).

differences.difference: Bounded fuel calculation: the mock shows a monospace calculation block; the app shows 'Not yet available ... no fuel quantity, saving or money claim'.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (S3 makes no fuel claim).

differences.difference: Coverage, confidence and alternatives: the mock has an Issue / Evidence interpretation / Effect table (4 rows) and a footer notice; the app has a key/value list, a versions list and a disclosure.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (alternatives recorded only as stored wording) + D4.

differences.difference: Physical asset condition: the app shows 1 battery row against the mock's 3 assets (battery, generator, inverter). The app's 'Open findings' and 'Open work' read 'Not recorded'; it adds a lead sentence 'Condition cannot yet be judged' and a line that other assets have no condition read; its link is 'Open battery' where the mock has 'Open asset'.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL (b) D1 (no condition read for other assets; no Finding/Work link per asset).

differences.difference: The left rail shows 'Assets — Not available yet' and 'Settings — Not available yet' (live entries in the mock). This is shell scope.
differences.proposal: PROPOSAL cross-reference to batch 1 shell; R21 covers subtab entries only, so a rail row is needed (D1/D2) if batch 1 has not raised it.
